load_roc_auc_metric: load the roc_auc metric module from the Hugging Face evaluate library
compute_roc_auc_score: compute the ROC AUC score given predictions and reference labels for binary classification
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the roc_auc metric
add_roc_auc_predictions: add prediction and reference data incrementally to the roc_auc metric for batched evaluation
get_roc_auc_info: retrieve metadata and description information about the roc_auc metric
